name: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Practice
description: A practical course on Microsoft's Copilot inside Microsoft 365: what each license tier can actually see, how Graph grounding and permissions shape every answer, and how to get reliable work out of Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, agents, Pages and Notebooks. It closes with the data protection controls and adoption metrics that decide whether a rollout succeeds.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Practice

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 16 lessons in 5 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
